intro: Arms Of Support Initiative is a Ugandan organisation dedicated to empowering vulnerable children through education, health, and community support.
vision: A Uganda where every child has access to education, health, and a safe home.
mission: To rescue, nurture, and educate vulnerable children through community-based programs and international partnership.
partnership: We are proudly supported by sponsors from the Netherlands, Belgium, and other European countries who share our vision of hope and opportunity.
